tips.text: Do the research in a Ghost clan if you control it; each clan tier multiplies research costs.
Queue Akstiletto, Sybaris and Veldt back to back so the 72-hour timers run while you play.
Gather the 10 Morphics on Mars or Phobos while doing other content; it is the one scarce input.
Players treat the Veldt as something to build and rank for Mastery, not to farm hard for.
